description: Edge case: m014_state=TRANSITION with both staking and stability commitments. The effective multiplier must be MAX(staking_mult, stability_mult) per SPEC section 5.3 — the transition phase honors whichever multiplier is currently higher so validators are not punished during the handover. staking_mult = 1 + 75T/150T = 1.5; stability_mult = 1 + 120T/150T = 1.8; effective = max = 1.8.
